method: Pillow reads current source PNG bytes; alpha>0 bbox, exact facing reflection about anchor133,167. Computes logical geometric projection only; this is not GPU visibility, lighting, occlusion, or airborne-height validation.
source_png_manifest_hash_format: UTF-8 sorted lines of res://path SPACE sha256 followed by newline
limitations: Covers each retained raw pose and authored walk/dash derived PNG at both legal horizontal edges with snapped camera offsets and y345.
Does not claim that every pose is unoccluded by scenery; native96-case framebuffer checks separately establish representative rendered visibility.
Airborne position and moving-camera lag are covered by the native motion route, not this fixed-ground projection calculation.

static_target_revalidation.note: The 190 source-pixels/second easing cap limits advance(delta) between dynamic samples. It does not change target_x(), the vertical target(), or snapped static offsets; all496 fixed-ground projection bounds are unchanged.
